title: Operational choreography: scheduled active-passive switchover rehearsals, KV snapshot verification, and progressive load-throttle patterns
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Purpose: Define a repeatable, cross-team operational choreography for active->passive switchover rehearsals that exercises SLO guardrails, circuit-breaker hysteresis, and backup/restore integrity. This ticket codifies the end-to-end sequence (preparation, controlled switchover, progressive load-throttle, KV snapshot cross-validation, and post-drill verification) plus automation artifacts and success criteria. The goal is to reduce cognitive load for on-call and platform teams during scheduled drills and to validate that fallback strategies maintain customer-facing SLOs in degraded modes.
acceptance_criteria: A reproducible rehearsal run initiated from Jenkins/GitHub Actions that executes the choreography without manual step-by-step orchestration
Automated KV snapshot verification compares checksums of primary and passive region snapshots and reports mismatches to the incident channel
Canary validator (traffic micro-batch) verifies cold KV-cache hit rate >= 80% and tail latency p95 < 300ms in passive region under progressive load
Circuit-breaker thresholds exercised: open/half-open transitions triggered and observed; hysteresis parameters tuned so automatic recovery within 10m without operator intervention
Post-drill SLO report generated and saved to the resilience dashboard with diffs vs baseline (token-level error rates, p50/p95/p99 latency, error budget burn)
Runbook notes, lessons learned, and follow-up tickets created in Confluence and linked in this Linear issue
pre_drill_checklist: Confirm snapshot rotation health and last-blob timestamp within 30m for both primary and passive regions
Notify customers (if drill impacts any reserved dedicated capacity) and update status page maintenance window
Ensure recent infra IaC PR (infra/region-routing) is merged and no pending DB schema migrations are in-flight
Bump telemetry retention for drill window and create ephemeral tracespace to collect full KV/route traces
Ensure SRE on-call and platform PM are assigned to the drill: SRE: Marco Nguyen, Platform PM: Elena Rossi
Dry run runbook in staging at least 48h before production rehearsal
choreography_steps: T-60m: Lock release gates, freeze scheduled deploys for the drill window (automation via release-bot)
T-30m: Snapshot export start: trigger KV snapshot job with verify=true flag; wait for job completion OK
T-15m: Create canary traffic plan in traffic-siphon service; allocate 5% of prod read-only requests to passive region for warmup
T0: Flip traffic routing policy to 'staged-siphon' with tiered weights (5% -> 20% -> 50% per step), using progressive load-throttle automation
T+5m: At each step, run health probes: API status, KV cache hit-rate, tokenstore restore sanity. If any probe fails, retarget to previous step and trigger circuit breaker to open for that route
T+15m: Initiate controlled stateful failover: promote passive region read path to accept limited writes (canary writes) while primary continues ingesting at reduced weight
T+25m: Execute full passive promotion in staging rehearsal only (production rehearsals keep write promotion as a simulated check unless explicitly scheduled)
T+30m: Begin rollback sequence: shift weights back in reverse staircase and run snapshot reconciliation to ensure no divergence
verification_steps: Checksum parity: run 'kv-snapshot-verify --primary=gs://snap-primary --passive=gs://snap-passive' and expect zero mismatches
Functional canary: POST /generate with sample prompt set; validate output schema and deterministic tokens for seeded prompts
Load-shedding response policy: under high-latency conditions, the system should return 429 with Retry-After per route configured, not 500
Circuit-breaker telemetry: confirm open_count, half_open_count, success_count are logged and surfaced in the resilience dashboard
SLO gates: error budget consumption < 30% for drill window; if >30% immediately abort and run post-mortem
rollback_plan: If any mandatory verification fails or SLO breach >= 30% is detected: 1) Immediately re-route all traffic to primary region using emergency route (route-id: emergency-direct) 2) Mark passive region as quarantined and start forensic snapshot export, 3) Open severity-2 incident, notify execs and customers as required, 4) Run snapshot rehydrate validation before any subsequent promotion attempts. All rollback actions must be recorded in the drill log and a follow-up post-mortem created within 48h.
metrics_and_slos: Primary SLOs to monitor: p99 latency < 1.2s, p95 latency < 450ms, token-level error rate < 0.2%
Passive rehearsal thresholds: p95 < 600ms, p99 < 1.5s (during stepped ramp), token-error < 0.5%
Circuit-breaker policy: open_threshold = 0.05 (5% error rate over 1m window), half_open_probe = 10 requests, close_success_window = 5m
Load-throttle algorithm: staircase throttle (5 -> 20 -> 50 -> 100) with 5m observation windows and automated pause-on-regression
KV cache warmup target: cold-warm transition hit-rate >= 70% after 10m of staged traffic
